thread:
maria: Need a lightweight "launch mini-kit" for the SMB push. Concise bundle for sales and paid channels: single-page benchmark infographic, three ad hero sizes, a simplified technical diagram (caching + batching), one webinar title slide + one inside slide, and a small GIF for social. Deadline: final exports next Monday; first visual drafts by Thursday morning.

sam_design: I can take this. Quick Q: do we have strict sizing for paid vs organic? Also confirm export formats (PNG/SVG/PDF) and whether we want separate layers for localization.

maria: Yes on layers. Priorities: 1) paid hero set (short headline variants for A/B) 2) one-pager benchmark (PNG + editable fig) 3) diagram (SVG + PNG) 4) webinar slides (PPTX + fig) 5) GIF for organic. Keep copy minimal for paid: 120char headline + CTA.

jordan_pm: Brand rules: use Type Scale v2, primary palette only (no legacy gradients). Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for any body text; provide alternate token for microcopy if needed. Include alt text for the infographic and simple captions for social.

brandbot: Auto-check: primary token passes for headings. --redwood-primary-soft fails AA at 14px body; recommend --redwood-secondary for small text or bump size.

sam_design: Noted. Sketching spec:

``
Assets:
- Paid hero tiles: 1200x628 (LinkedIn), 1080x1080 (IG), 1200x675 (Twitter) -> export @2x PNG + source .fig
- One-pager benchmark: 1125x1500 -> export PNG + PDF + .fig
- Diagram: 1200x800 SVG (layers + labeled components) + PNG fallback
- Webinar slides: 1920x1080 .fig + PPTX export with speaker notes
- GIF: 1080x1080 or 820x312, max 450KB, 3s loop
Naming: rdw_launchkit_<asset>_<variant>_v1.png
Color: use --redwood-primary, --redwood-dark, --neutral-contrast
Type: Redwood Display (H1), Redwood Text (body)
Localization: separate text layers FR/DE (placeholders)
Accessibility: alt text file included per asset
```

leo_marketing: For paid we need a reduced-copy variant (15-char headline + CTA) and a longer organic variant for social. Also request a set of 3 stat callouts (latency, cost reduction, uptime) — short strings only so they fit hero tiles.

ava_ops: Handoff checklist: export assets to s3://redwood-marketing/launch-smb/ and duplicate the fig into Marketing > Launchs project. Include a small readme.txt with usage rules and export manifest. Also ping infra for CDN invalidation notes if necessary.

sam_design: Will do. Emoji/icon style? New line+fill icon set or legacy flat? Smaller file sizes preferred.

maria: Use the new line+fill icons, but keep illustrations to two colors max to keep PNG/GIF sizes down.

sam_design: Timeline: initial Figma frames and hero drafts by Thu 9am, one-pager draft Thu 5pm, diagram sketch Fri morning, GIF prototype Fri afternoon, final exports next Mon. I'll flag any blockers early.

jordan_pm: I'll supply short/long headlines and the 3 stat callouts by Wed EOD. Also will add localization copy stubs for FR/DE.

leo_marketing: Dropping stat lines now: 
- "<50ms p50 latency"
- "up to 7x lower per-token cost"
- "99.95% SLA"
Use these as short callouts.

ava_ops: Reminder: when exporting PPTX include speaker notes with the TL;DR and single-line talking points. Also include a slide usage license snippet: "Marketing use only; partner reuse requires approval."

brandbot: Style lint: ensure headings use letterspacing -0.02em and avoid stroke effects on small text.

sam_design: All clear, will tag @maria and @leo in the Fig file. Anyone else with must-have messaging or stats, add now.

maria: That's it for now. Thanks team! :tada:
